notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

It’s been a while since we shared our progress, so we are happy to finally give you an update on what we have been working on!

First of all, I’m proud to show off the current talent tree. We added 10(!) new talents so far, which brings the current total to 19, more than twice the amount of the Demo!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/9ea78f47fe45f9ed2186c56e2c87e3781c362806.png"]

I don’t want to spoil them all already, so you can speculate a bit based on the icons. Let’s take a look at only two of the new talents for now.



The first is one of the most suggested talents from the community, oxidizing copper coins. When you don’t interact with copper coins for a while they start to oxidize and then grant bonus money when you ultimately flip them.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/f1218ee7f29d978312591816e42bc7a8548fdf96.png"]



The second one has been super fun to animate and made me laugh a few times^^

you vs. the guy she told you not to worry about:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/5409f94ccd43ac324ad670c84c21fc7494038680.gif"]

We have also been sharing some very early work in progress screenshots of a new thief-helper and the table select mechanic on our Discord. If you would like to see stuff early or want to suggest ideas for new talents, we’d love to have you join the Gamblers Table Discord! But we’ll of course also show the new features here once they are a little more polished.

 

Lastly, we have reached a new milestone: We surpassed 50k Wishlists, mainly due to a huge influx of Japanese players. It seems like a bunch of Japanese influencers discovered Gamblers Table and played it on their channels. Thank you all for playing and covering Gamblers Table and for wishlisting and for following the development!

私たちのコミュニティへようこそ

notes.title: Demo release date, 30k club and new features
notes.notes:
Great news! We have been hard at work on the upcoming steam demo and it even has a release date! We will launch the demo next week on the 23rd of July!

If you have played the prototype version on itch you might wonder what is going to be different in the Steam Demo. We actually overhauled it quite a lot:

The balancing has been dramatically improved

New prestige mechanic and a talent tree

9 unlockable talent points that have a significant impact on the gameplay

Achievements (only in-game, we will have proper Steam achievements in the full game)

New upgrades

New sprites, icons and animations

A bunch of crazy hats for the helpers

More languages! We support 15 languages now; this wouldn’t have been possible without the help of our amazing discord community, thank you all so much! If anyone finds an error in the localization, please let us know

Controller support

Steamdeck support

Twitch integration (You can have the helpers be named like people in your twitch chat and spout random chat messages)

Customizable table cloth



Next some good news, that probably nobody besides us devs cares about haha: We made it to 30k Wishlists and are moving steadily towards 40k! Thank you all for following us and contributing so much to the development of the game! We are going to run out of coin rain GIFs soon :D

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/16f5905677a6cab014787a08cab820693b5fc2f4.gif"]



And finally, let me share some visuals of new features:

As I mentioned above, you can now customize your table cloth, Greenpixels recorded a short video explaining the feature. We have already seen some really fun community designs in our discord!
[previewyoutube="mVEvT6FFTxc;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]


This is the first glimpse at the underlying lore of the game, it’s the animation that plays when players reset the game to start a new prestige run

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/317bca44565794bef0342f5fe24c03e8856c7603.gif"]



And here are two GIFs of upcoming mechanics (they are still “work in progress” and won’t be in the demo though), nothing out of the ordinary, just what you would expect from a game about flipping coins:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/d9bbb357af13be51281435f1332698ce1886c7ed.gif"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/52a9c37d630d8cfcae2e0fcb43855b2fa2727699.gif"]



And as always, if you want to particiapte in the development of Gamblers Table, join our discord and let us know your ideas or just hang out and chat with us: Discord Link
